The speaker praises Costco's focus on taking care of the customer, building quality long-term, and driving prices down rather than seeking short-term expediency.
The speaker mentions Amazon as a competitor that Charlie Munger believed would flatten Costco, noting that Amazon is now buying Whole Foods.
The speaker mentions Walmart as a competitor that Charlie Munger believed Costco would beat, noting that Costco successfully opened a unit in Bentonville.

thesis: This episode argues that Costco is a superior long-term investment due to its customer-centric focus and avoidance of short-term expediency, a strategy that has allowed it to successfully compete against both Amazon and Walmart.
